madeBy: studio programmer (run 2026-09-30-offline-games), lab prototype games/lab/omnom-rig.html v2 (reviews game-designer-rig-1, art-director-rig-1); to be moved next to omnom_rig.json by the art director; v3 programmer (D-56, rig data v2)
units: time in s; sq > 0 = stretch up, sq < 0 = squash; body scale around the feet sx = 1/(1+sq), sy = 1+sq (volume kept); lift = rig px up; lean = deg, + clockwise on screen; open = minimum mouth open 0..1; glance = gaze direction (-1..1) when the game gives no look target
layersNote: Two layers. BASE = body state (layer base): stand (idle, aim, anticipate), hang, fly - loops, never end by themselves; the game switches them. REACT = face and hands over the base (layer react): eat, joy, oops, whoosh, shrug, reach, wave, blink - when a reaction ends the body returns to the CURRENT base, not to idle. Merge: face bones (head, mouth, eyes, pupils, lids, sprout, body) = base + w * (reaction - neutral pose) (t, r added, s multiplied); body/eyes/lids form weights = lerp(base, reaction, w); mouth group, show/hide = reaction's when w >= 0.5; arms = front paws (arm/fore/paw_fl|paw_fr) = lerp(base, reaction, aw) only for the arms the state lets go: stand both, hang only the right paw (the left one is the grip_l on the rope), fly both; legs (paw_bl/paw_br) and root = base only; sq, lean added; lift added only when standing. w = key w * fade-in (clip fade) * fade-out (last fadeOut s); aw = key aw * the same (0 for clips with arms false).
keysNote: pose = pose name (omnom_rig.json poses or this file's poses) or {name: weight}; a key without pose keeps the previous pose; sq/lift/lean/open/glance/w/aw carry forward; bones = additive offsets for this key only ({t:[x,y], r: deg, s:[x,y] multiplies}); lids = replace lid weights for this key only. ease = how the segment ENDING at this key runs: lin, in, out, inout, hold (jump at the key). Mouth group switches (closed / open / sad / chew) happen exactly at the key where the new group appears - author those keys at a squash peak (D-51). A group change that is not authored (fade, the open param, a reaction over a different base face) is delayed by blipMs/2 and gets a small squash blip.
partsNote: Parametric clips (intro / loop / outro) take dur and rate from the game: loop keys (t in (0, cycle]) repeat round((dur - intro end - outro length) / (cycle / rate)) times, stretched to fill dur exactly; 0 repeats = the short version (joy 0.6: jump and joy without the second bounce). replayFrom: the same reaction played again before its outro starts jumps straight to that time (eat: the gulp at the squash peak, hands stay at the face).
posesNote: custom pose = base pose + bones (set, not added) + front (parts drawn in front) + armsFrom (copy arm/fore/hand bones and their front flags from another pose) + forms (replace body / eyes / lids form).

squash.note: second-order follow of the keyed sq (t3ssel8r form: f Hz, zeta damping, r initial response): overshoot = jelly settle

tilt.note: whole-body tilt: on a rope exactly 0.6 of the rope angle, max +-40 deg, around the grip (after a grab: smooth blend from the flight tilt over grabS); in flight along the velocity: rising = 90 - elevation (body axis along v), falling = 90 + elevation * fallK (feet swing down to grab), max +-60 (at the apex of a flight the body lies at 60, not 90: a face lying on its side read badly while eating), around the body centre

head.note: head lags vertical acceleration of the body (rig px)

sprout.note: tip point on a spring in world space; deflection angle around sprout1 split over 3 links (gains); lag 80-120 ms (D-51). Rig 2.1: asymmetric limit - bending down-right (+) the bulb reaches the head: the artist's limit +25, at +25 the bulb already touches the head outline in the lab render, so +20; up-left (-) to -40

paws.note: dangle only in the air (rope, flight); only the back lobes (legs): the front paws ride on the arm chain

gaze.note: pupils first (exp. smoothing tau), body lean follows the same look 100 ms later; each pupil clamped into the travel ellipse of ITS eye (omnom_rig.json anchors.pupils)

blink.note: close ease-in (u^2), hold, open fast then slowing down: closed = (1-u)^3 -> at 133 ms from the start the eye is ~89 % open, fully open at 185 ms

tremble.note: anticipation tremble, amplitude = base + (1 - base) * open from the game (0..1, distance candy..mouth): grows as the candy comes closer; fades under a reaction

open.note: open 0..1 = (far - distance candy..mouth) / (far - near), u; far is a game parameter; neutral->ajar switches the mouth group at 0.15 (blip)

speedStretch.note: speed 0..1 = (|v| - v0) / (v1 - v0) u/s -> stretch along the velocity, volume kept; D-56: at most 1.5 % (was 20 %), the stretch matrix itself is smoothed (tau s) so speed / direction changes never jump

react.note: cancelBlink: a startle opens the eyes at once (a blink in progress is dropped); the last fadeOut s of a reaction blend its face back to the base face (stand: the same neutral; fly: ajar); clips with arms lower them by keys (aw 0) before this window

air.note: D-56 (user: 'should not squash strangely on the swing'): on the rope and in flight the keyed squash of reactions and the mouth-switch blip are scaled by sqK and capped at sqMax; head lag gain x headK, cap headMaxPx. Squash stays on the ground only (anticipation crouch, landing of the joy jump, gulp). Measured whole-body axis deviation on the swing: getState().om.axisDev

hang.note: on the rope arm_l (and its child grip_l) turns by (rope angle - body tilt) so the body swings under the arm; the hang pose's own slant of the grip (rig v2: raised diagonally like the v2 frame) is kept. Limits in arm_l local degrees: away from the head up to armMaxDeg (rig v2 grip base shows jaggies past ~20), toward the head up to armInDeg (the grip is drawn behind the body: further in, the fist disappears behind the head). Body tilt stays 0.6 of the rope angle (tilt); rope point = anchors.hands.grip_l, pinned to the rope end

eatOut.note: exit from eating: mouth closed and lids half at the squash peak, hands still at the face (lowered over the next 90 ms)

handsDown.note: exit of eat / joy / shrug / wave: the front paws come down IN FRONT of the belly almost to their place on the ground (arm and forearm already behind the body - they swap mid-arc, out to the side); next key = neutral with aw 0: the paws drop behind the body outline at the middle of that last segment, already at the ground

joyUp.note: jump of joy: arms raised (fly arms) on the take-off, in front of the body

joyOut.note: exit from joy: lids half, mouth closed at the squash peak, arms (still in front) start down

startle.note: miss: flinch with small pupils and a small mouth (not the wide red mouth of anticipation)

sadOut.note: exit from sad through half lids

shrug.note: dead end of the box: front paws out to the sides, forearms up (palms up), wide face

eatGulp.note: next candy of a series: the mouth opens for the gulp while the front paws stay at the mouth

waveA.note: D-66: the raised front paw is drawn IN FRONT of the body (whole arm chain); the swap with the body happens mid-arc, where the arm is out to the side (smallest visible change)

handsMid.note: polish (D-66): midpoint of the eat exit chosen by search so the paws go from the mouth to the ground almost in a straight line (the left paw used to swing out wide to the side, 78 px off the line; now 1.3 px, the right 33 -> 8)

gulpMid.note: polish: the paws go up to the mouth along the same near-straight path as on the exit (not out wide to the side)

idle.note: 3 variants picked at random each pass so the rest never repeats; not while aiming (aim)

aim.note: while the player aims: no rest variants, eyes on the candy (the game gives look), mouth at least ajar

anticipate.note: crouch, then up on the toes; tremble grows with open (motion.tremble); the mouth follows the open param (at least ajar)

eat.note: D-66 (user: 'eat even slower'): 1.4 s by default. Gulp 0.22 s (wide2 -> chew at the squash peak at 0.12, paws to the mouth) -> chew loop (cycle 0.4 = 2 bites, fitted into dur: 0.22 s per switch at 1.4) -> exit 0.3 s: squash peak = mouth closed + lids half, paws down in front of the belly to the ground. Series: dur 1.0, every next candy restarts with replayIntro (a full gulp). Option k (lab slider 'eat speed'): all times x k (k = slider / 1.4), so a faster eat stays a whole eat

joy.note: crouch (switch to joy at its peak) -> jump with raised arms (lift only when standing) -> land squash -> bounce loop (0 at 0.6 s, 1 at 0.9, 2 at 1.4) -> rebound, squash peak = half lids + closed mouth, arms down 90 ms

oops.note: miss: flinch at once (startle: small pupils, small mouth, stretch) -> sad at the squash peak at 0.15 s -> half lids at the squash peak at 0.5 -> neutral; no arms, so in the air it keeps the flight pose

whoosh.note: wide2 face 0.25 s on the sweet release (Rope'n'Fly v2 'whoosh'), stretch along the flight

shrug.note: dead end of the box (blocks.md): wide 1.0 s, shoulders up twice with a sway, exit through half lids (squash peak at 0.82), arms down by 0.92

reach.note: hint without text: dip, reach out to the left (viewer side), wiggle the paw, back

wave.note: D-66: hand in front of the body; polish: a wider wave (arm +-16, paw +-22 deg) so it reads as waving, not a raised hand

blink.note: starts the blink (motion.blink) now; changes nothing else (w 0)

rigNote: v3 (D-56): works on omnom_rig.json version 2 - arms = front paws (body > arm > fore > paw_fl / paw_fr; paw_f* take only r and a uniform s), legs = back lobes paw_bl / paw_br (the only dangle springs), hang = grip_l (child of arm_l) shown, arm_l / fore_l / paw_fl hidden; on the rope arm_l turns the grip along the rope (motion.hang) and anchors.hands.grip_l is pinned to the rope end. Pose patches hangRig / flyRig / flyWideRig / sadRig removed: rig v2 poses are used as is.
